title: Financial Consumer Protection Digital Scam Prevention and Cyber Fraud Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing strict bank liability and mandatory 5-day customer reimbursement for reported digital financial fraud, ban on illegal lending apps, biometric SIM verification, and Fast-Track Cyber Crime Special Courts.
notes: Matter 025: Financial Consumer Protection Digital Scam Prevention and Cyber Fraud Bill, 2026.
